videos.title: A Lot Like Christmas
videos.description: Jessica owns the most popular Christmas tree lot in Hudson Springs, but when big-city marketing executive Clay Moore moves a big box chain store into the area and starts selling trees, Jessica finds her business in jeopardy.

videos.title: A Paris Christmas Waltz
videos.description: Emma encounters a professional dancer Leo, whose enthusiasm for competitive dancing is diminishing. However, a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity presents itself for the novice to join the pro.

videos.title: Christmas at the Inn
videos.description: Beth Green, a devoted café owner, returns to her hometown of Snow Ridge to help her parents host the town's most cherished tradition, the annual Yuletide Potluck, a holiday potluck that welcomes military families and veterans who might otherwise spend Christmas alone. At her parents' cozy inn, Beth meets Jack Evans, a civil engineer with the military, assigned to oversee projects at the local base over Christmas.

videos.title: Karen Kingsbury's The Christmas Ring
videos.description: A military widow meets an antiques dealer while searching for her family's long-lost heirloom ring. Their friendship promises to turn into a breathtaking romance, but shocking news hits right before Christmas.

videos.title: Christmas at the Drive-In
videos.description: A property lawyer finds romance during the holidays while trying to save her town's local drive-in from closing down.

videos.title: An Ozark Mountain Christmas
videos.description: A designer visits her Ozark hometown for Christmas, reconnecting with family craft traditions and faith. Through Paul's support, she discovers meaning in work centered on community and heritage.

videos.title: Silver Bells at Christmas
videos.description: Determined to save her mother's Christmas shop, Ginny must choose between protecting the past she loves and embracing a future that could change her heart forever.

videos.title: A Little Women's Christmas
videos.description: A contemporary retelling of the classic novel "Little Women," following the lives and loves of the March sisters in a small Tennessee town during Christmastime.

videos.title: Three Generations, One Christmas
videos.description: Three generations of family are drawn into an emotional journey when a legendary song-and-dance man prepares to sell his beloved restaurant lounge.

videos.title: A Rescue Dog for Christmas
videos.description: A physician and a traveling veterinarian unite to organize a Christmas pet adoption event and discover that the greatest Christmas miracle may be finding a place where both hearts find shelter.

videos.title: A Sweet Christmas Anniversary
videos.description: In the third Home Sweet Christmas story, Sophie and Sam travel to festive Budapest to celebrate their first anniversary, but their romantic getaway soon turns into a mystery when a charismatic hotelier pulls them into a world of surprises.

videos.title: The Trouble With Christmas Mistletoe
videos.description: An executive returns home for Christmas and reconnects with the former fiancé she left behind. As the traditions of her hometown rekindle old memories, she begins to wonder if the life she walked away from may still be the one meant for her.

videos.title: Fir Crazy
videos.description: A reluctant Christmas-tree seller (Sarah Lancaster) finds renewed holiday spirit and new romance with a repeat customer (Eric Johnson), but a mean-spirited executive (Colin Mochrie) threatens to shut down her family's business.

videos.title: A Royal Christmas Tail
videos.description: A prince swaps a glass slipper for a dog tag in his Christmas search for the woman and her dog who stole his heart during one enchanted holiday encounter.

videos.title: A Second Chance Christmas
videos.description: Divorced for five years, Anna and James reluctantly agree to meet their daughter's boyfriend at a rustic cabin. But when an ice storm traps them in the mountains, they're forced to confront the history they share as old feelings resurface.

videos.title: Christmas North of Nashville
videos.description: A woman rediscovers love, community, and the holiday spirit after returning home to save her family's Christmas carnival.

videos.title: Chasing Christmas
videos.description: When a Christmas wishes tree brings together an artist and a morning show host, they set out on a mission to make a child's holiday dreams come true.

videos.title: Destined at Christmas
videos.description: After Kim and Theo meet in the midst of Black Friday shopping madness, they are determined to meet again.

videos.title: The Christmas Yes List
videos.description: A chronic people-pleaser returns home for Christmas, determined to finally say yes to herself. An unexpected romance helps her discover that life's greatest gifts often come when you stop fearing the answer.

videos.title: Let It Snow
videos.description: An executive examines her company's new property and prepares a presentation to transform the rustic lodge into a new hot spot. She tries to ignore the lodge's festive celebrations during her stay, but an unexpected romance changes her heart.

videos.title: A Rescue Dog for Christmas
videos.description: A physician and a traveling veterinarian unite to organize a Christmas pet adoption event and discover that the greatest Christmas miracle may be finding a place where both hearts find shelter.

videos.title: The Greatest Christmas Gift
videos.description: When a setback threatens their Christmas wedding, Emma and Caleb rely on faith, love and community.

videos.title: A Christmas Prayer Tradition
videos.description: When a girl quietly begins a mission to answer the prayers and needs of those around her community, her family discovers that some of God's greatest works are accomplished through simple acts of kindness.

videos.title: Christmas at Moose Lake
videos.description: When successful New Yorker Alyssa Dawson retreats to her family's lakeside cabin for Christmas to heal from a painful breakup, she is forced to confront shifting family dynamics and past grief. But as she reconnects with Sean, a thoughtful.

videos.title: B&B Merry
videos.description: Graham Cooper invites renowned travel blogger Tracey Wise on a Christmas getaway in exchange for her review of his family's small bed & breakfast, Silver Peak. Unfortunately, the humble B&B is facing tough competition from an upscale hotel resort that's been stealing guests and threatening the survival of the family business.

videos.title: A Royal Icing Christmas
videos.description: A secret baking contest and an unexpected romance teach a duty-bound princess that love may be life's true crowning achievement.

videos.title: Silver Bells at Christmas
videos.description: Determined to save her mother's Christmas shop, Ginny must choose between protecting the past she loves and embracing a future that could change her heart forever.

videos.title: Matchmaker Christmas
videos.description: As the Christmas party for a book publishing company approaches, editor Maggie volunteers to help her boss, Amanda, find a date.

videos.title: A Dash of Christmas
videos.description: To apply for her dream job at a foodie startup, an executive must learn to bake. When she recruits a handsome baker to help her, she inadvertently ends up in a Christmas Bake-off.

videos.title: Joy for Christmas
videos.description: A publicist introduces a famous athlete to the joys of Christmas in the hopes that he will assist her in saving her family's annual charity.

videos.title: A Christmas Miracle for Daisy
videos.description: Interior designer Whitney Alder agrees to work for her ex-boyfriend Cormac, who has adopted his orphaned niece, Daisy. Daisy's Christmas wish is for Whitney and Cormac to get together so she can have the mother she always wanted.

videos.title: An Ozark Mountain Christmas
videos.description: A designer visits her Ozark hometown for Christmas, reconnecting with family craft traditions and faith. Through Paul's support, she discovers meaning in work centered on community and heritage.

videos.title: The Greatest Christmas Gift
videos.description: When a setback threatens their Christmas wedding, Emma and Caleb rely on faith, love and community.

videos.title: A Sweet Christmas Anniversary
videos.description: In the third Home Sweet Christmas story, Sophie and Sam travel to festive Budapest to celebrate their first anniversary, but their romantic getaway soon turns into a mystery when a charismatic hotelier pulls them into a world of surprises.

videos.title: Christmas Keepsake
videos.description: Following their move to a new city, a father bonds with his daughter and stumbles upon an unexpected romance while tracking down the original owner of a Christmas time capsule.

videos.title: Three Generations, One Christmas
videos.description: Three generations of family are drawn into an emotional journey when a legendary song-and-dance man prepares to sell his beloved restaurant lounge.
